findings.title: dotenv-read rule hard-blocks non-secret .env.example/.env.sample templates and *.env.ts sources
findings.evidence: db5b8c34 changed guard.rs:180-194 so .env must start a path segment, which no longer matches app.env.ts. Capture group 1 is checked by is_dotenv_template_suffix (guard.rs:250-256, :263-279), exempting example/sample/template, with test guard.rs:678. NEW REGRESSION introduced by this fix, verified with the same regex under Python re (same leftmost-first semantics): classify_bash_command uses re.captures(), the first match only, and skips the whole rule when that capture is a template. As a result 'cat .env .env.example' (the greedy prefix captures .env.example), 'cat .env.example; cat .env' and 'head .env.sample && tail .env' are no longer blocked, and real .env secrets can be read through run_process/terminal_script.
